text:
My day follows a predictable rhythm, which helps me stay productive. I wake up at six-thirty each morning and start with a glass of water and ten minutes of stretching. After a quick shower, I have a light breakfast of oatmeal and fruit.

My work schedule begins at nine. I usually spend the morning on deep-focus tasks like writing reports and answering emails. After lunch, I attend meetings and collaborate with my team.

In the late afternoon, I go for a thirty-minute run or do a yoga session at home. This keeps my energy up and clears my mind. Evenings are for cooking dinner, reading a chapter of a book, and relaxing with family. I’m in bed by ten-thirty. Consistency in this routine gives me a sense of calm and accomplishment.
